narr: Sustained monsoonal flow brought more flooding to southeast Idaho on July 31st.
ev: A National Weather Service Storm Survey found evidence of high water along several stretches of Arbon Valley Road. Road and Bridge crews called out to clear off extensive debris caused by the flash flooding on the roadway.
A NWS storm survey found flooding had occurred on Highway 36 with damage to culverts. Idaho Transportation Department was cleaning up debris.

The US Forest Service reported Trapper Creek Road washed out in the area of FS Road 538 to Trout Creek Pass. A 12 foot deep gully was running down the center of the road. This was due to excessive runoff from the burned canyon walls from the Badger Fire burn scar.
